description: Linux kernel module source code for u-boot environment in RAM, implementing device driver functions including read, write, ioctl, and platform driver registration.

methods.name: to_ubootenv_drvdata
methods.description: Converts a file pointer to ubootenv_drvdata structure.

methods.name: ubootenv_write
methods.description: Handles writing data to the u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_read
methods.description: Handles reading data from the u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_llseek
methods.description: Handles seeking within the u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for the u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver when the device is probed.

methods.name: ubootenv_remove
methods.description: Cleans up when the device is removed.
